paragraphs.text: Full-time position. You must have held a clean driving licence for at least two years. Early starts from 5 am. A company van is provided, and wages are paid weekly.
Part-time, three days a week. Previous experience on reception is preferred, but full training will be given. A friendly manner is essential. Staff receive free dental treatment.
A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January. Evening and night shifts, with a higher rate of pay after 10 pm. No experience needed. Please apply online by 30 September.
Full-time. A recognised childcare qualification is required. We will pay for staff to complete further training. Working hours are 8 am to 6 pm on a rota.

Weekend work, Saturday and Sunday. You will manage a small team and be responsible for cashing up at the end of the day. A share of tips is paid monthly. Applicants must be available to start in early November.

items.quote: A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January
items.prompt: is only for a limited period

explanation.en: The warehouse job is “A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January”, so it is for a limited period only → C.
explanation.kk: Қоймадағы жұмыс — «A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January», яғни тек шектеулі мерзімге → C.
explanation.ru: Работа на склад — «A temporary contract for our busy period from October to January», то есть только на ограниченный срок → C.

items.quote: A recognised childcare qualification is required

explanation.en: “A recognised childcare qualification is required” → D. A asks for driving experience, not a qualification, and B only “prefers” experience.
explanation.kk: «A recognised childcare qualification is required» → D. A-да жүргізуші куәлігі мен өтілі талап етіледі, біліктілік емес; B-да тәжірибе тек «preferred».
explanation.ru: «A recognised childcare qualification is required» → D. В A нужны водительские права — это стаж вождения, а не квалификация; B лишь «preferred» опыт.

items.prompt: offers a benefit linked to what the employer does

explanation.en: A dental practice gives staff “free dental treatment” — a benefit from its own business → B.
explanation.kk: Тіс емханасы қызметкерлерге «free dental treatment» береді — өз саласындағы жеңілдік → B.
explanation.ru: Стоматология даёт сотрудникам «free dental treatment» — льготу из своей же сферы → B.

items.quote: You will manage a small team
items.prompt: involves being in charge of other staff

explanation.en: Managing people is part of the café job: “You will manage a small team”. “Be in charge of” means “manage” → E.
explanation.kk: Адамдарды басқару кафеде болады: «You will manage a small team». «Be in charge of» — «manage» дегенмен бірдей → E.
explanation.ru: Руководить людьми предстоит в кафе: «You will manage a small team». «Be in charge of» значит то же, что «manage» → E.

items.quote: You must have held a clean driving licence for at least two years
items.prompt: asks for a certain amount of driving experience

explanation.en: The driver must have “held a clean driving licence for at least two years”. That is a set amount of driving experience → A.
explanation.kk: Жүргізушіге кемінде екі жылдық куәлік керек: «You must have held a clean driving licence for at least two years». Бұл — белгілі бір жүргізу өтілі → A.
explanation.ru: Водителю нужны права минимум два года: «You must have held a clean driving licence for at least two years». Это и есть определённый стаж вождения → A.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five job advertisements, A–E. Which advertisement mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E.
